display.title: Dialing Hashem: Saying Every Word of the Shema Clearly
display.summary_short: Davening is like a telephone call: say each word of the Shema clearly to 'dial the right number', and Hashem always answers.
display.summary_long: A Mitzvah Time lesson from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, continuing a series on reciting the Shema. Uncle Yossi reviews last week's words, Kabbalas ol malchus Shamayim: accepting Hashem as our King and taking on the yoke of Torah and mitzvos, like the yoke on a horse that lets it pull a wagon. Then he teaches a new rule, in the spirit of the Baal Shem Tov's teaching that we can learn how to serve Hashem from everything we see and hear. Davening is like using a telephone. Holding the phone is not enough; you have to speak, and you have to dial the correct number, or you reach the wrong person. In the same way, when we say the Shema we must pronounce every word carefully and clearly. Then our tefillah reaches Hashem, whose line is never busy, because He listens to everyone's prayer, and His brachah reaches us in full.
display.lesson: Say every word of the Shema and your tefillos clearly and carefully, and Hashem always listens.
